_comment: A fire dot aura: ignites up to 2 nearest enemies within 1.4 units, each burning for 4 ticks at 60-tick intervals for 10.5 HP plus 6.875 per level. Also gives the caster fire resistance, reducing fire damage taken to 60% and improving each level, and casts light out to 4 units growing 1 per level. Only charges its cost on a fresh ignition, not a refresh. All values placeholder.
name: Wildfire
